description.raw: '''Innate:''' Whenever '''Jinx''' scores a [[File:Damage rating.png|20px|link=Takedown|An icon representing the keyword Takedown]] [[:Takedown|takedown]] against an enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]], epic [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monster]], [[File:Turret icon.png|20px|link=Turret|An icon representing the keyword Turret]] [[:Turret|turret]], or [[inhibitor]] within 3 seconds of damaging them, she gains [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] 175% '''bonus''' movement speed decaying over 6 seconds.
description.text: Innate: Whenever Jinx scores a takedown against an enemy champion, epic monster, turret, or inhibitor within 3 seconds of damaging them, she gains  175% bonus movement speed decaying over 6 seconds.

description2.raw: Additionally, she is allowed to exceed the attack speed cap and gains a [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stack]] of ''Get Excited!'' for the same duration, stacking up to 5 times. Only [[File:Damage rating.png|20px|link=Takedown|An icon representing the keyword Takedown]] [[:Takedown|takedowns]] against enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]] can grant stacks beyond the first.
description2.text: Additionally, she is allowed to exceed the attack speed cap and gains a stack of Get Excited! for the same duration, stacking up to 5 times. Only takedowns against enemy champions can grant stacks beyond the first.

description3.raw: '''Get Excited!:''' For each stack, '''Jinx''' gains [[File:Attack speed icon.png|15px|link=Attack speed]] 25% '''total''' attack speed, up to a maximum of 125%.
description3.text: Get Excited!: For each stack, Jinx gains  25% total attack speed, up to a maximum of 125%.

notes.raw: * '''Jinx's''' ''attack speed cap'' is increased to 90.0 for the duration, however this value is already beyond the technical limit for attack speed. * '''Jinx''' will still trigger ''Get Excited'' from killing a summoned [[File:Rift HeraldSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Rift Herald|An icon representing Rift Herald]] [[Rift Herald]]. * '''Jinx''' will fail to trigger ''Get Excited'' in the specific circumstance of killing [[File:Baron NashorSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Baron Nashor|An icon representing Baron Nashor]] [[Baron Nashor]] while more than ~2500 distance away.(bug)
notes.text:
Jinx's attack speed cap is increased to 90.0 for the duration, however this value is already beyond the technical limit for attack speed.
Jinx will still trigger Get Excited from killing a summoned Rift Herald.
Jinx will fail to trigger Get Excited in the specific circumstance of killing Baron Nashor while more than ~2500 distance away.(bug)
